evals.prompt: Using Huub in Rust, list every pair of whole numbers x and y in 0..=5 with x + y = 7 and x <= y.
evals.expected_output: A Cargo program that lowers the model and enumerates all solutions over x and y with all_solutions and satisfy
assertions: Posts both constraints with post() and handles the Result (with ? or unwrap), not ignoring it
Lowers with m.lower().to_solver() and maps each view with map.get before solving
Lists the distinct solutions over the two views with all_solutions and ends with satisfy

evals.prompt: Write a Huub Rust model that maximises profit 3x + 2y for whole numbers with x + y <= 4 and x + 3y <= 6, and prints the optimum only when it is proven.
evals.expected_output: A program that ties the objective to an integer view, calls maximize on a fresh solver, and reports only a Complete result
assertions: Calls maximize (not minimize) on the objective view as the first solve on the solver
Prints the value only when the status is Complete with Some(value)
Ties the objective view to the linear expression with a constraint, not by bounding it by hand

evals.prompt: Count the Hamiltonian cycles on five nodes in Huub, which has no circuit constraint.
evals.expected_output: A decomposition of circuit over successor variables that enumerates over the successors and reports 24
assertions: Uses successor variables with domain 0..=4 and makes them all different and non-self-loops
Adds a visiting order and element constraints that follow the successors through every node
Enumerates over the successor variables only, so the order variables do not repeat a count
